clips.send: Four Treasures of the Study. Brush, ink, paper and inkstone — 笔, 墨, 纸, 砚. Brushes are made of animal hair (goat, weasel, rabbit) set in bamboo. Ink sticks of soot and glue are ground with water on a stone inkstone. Xuan paper (宣纸) from Anhui soaks up ink instantly — no erasing! 笔墨纸砚: Brush, Ink, Paper, Stone.

clips.send: 文房四宝。笔、墨、纸、砚。 毛笔用羊毫、狼毫（黄鼠狼毛）、兔毫等装在竹管上。 墨条由烟灰和胶制成，加水在砚台上研磨。 安徽出产的宣纸吸墨极快——下笔无法擦改！ 笔墨纸砚，书房四宝。
